Only the water shader and license are vendored. The original shader is unmodified.
Project supplies procedural noise textures, a coastline-clipped grid and bounded SSR settings. Mobile renderer; no renderer/project settings changes.

Project derivative: ../coastal_water.gdshader preserves the MIT header and original shader; adjusts ripple normals to world space, shore foam to actual vertical depth, and softens foam edges.
